== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Lysander Torannus is an Avernus Travelers{{!}}Avernus Traveler and a prominent figure within the [[Sarin tribe]]. Known as Overlord Lysander, he is characterized by his scholarly nature, often wearing spectacles and buckskin clothing. He possesses a profound connection to his flock of [[Sarin tribe sparrows]], which he uses for reconnaissance and protection. While highly skilled in the art of [[Traveling]] through [[Avernus]], Lysander is noted for his lack of political acumen and creativity. He has pledged his loyalty to [[Talos]], the [[Damascan Heir]], with the shared ambition of establishing their rule over the world. Despite his status and capabilities, he has faced significant setbacks, including being imprisoned in a crystal coffin and later being declared a traitor by the [[Damascan]] [[Successor]] following an incident involving a boy named [[Simon]]. He is also the brother of Overlord Feiora Torannus.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The Crimson Vault}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Lysander Torannus is an Overlord and an Avernus Travelers{{!}}Avernus Traveler who possesses golden hair and chiseled features.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c3">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c4">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c16">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 16</ref> A scholarly man dressed in feathered buckskin, he maintains his own realm and has spent years planning against King Zakareth VI{{!}}King Zakareth.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c3" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c10">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c15">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 15</ref> Having given his allegiance to [[Talos]], he is often seen with a flock of sparrows flying around his head and possesses the ability to produce a psychic scream from his hands.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c16" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c18">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 18</ref> After claiming to have seen the future, he attempted to assassinate a royal Heir and was eventually encased in a solid, translucent coffin of milky white crystal.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c20">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 20</ref> Ultimately, the Overlord sent a message declaring that the time for their strike had arrived.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c21">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 21</ref>}}
